description: Create house.kitchenware: knives, forks, spoons, pans and the rest, with brand, colour, model and size.
rationale: Cutlery is counted in sets rather than individually, so piece_count is on the row and one item is 'six forks' rather than six items.

intents.comment: Detail for an item of category kitchenware. One row per house.item row; the brand is on house.item.

columns.name: color_id
columns.comment: Colour, where the household distinguishes by it. Null for bare steel.

columns.name: model
columns.comment: Manufacturer's model name, where the box still exists.

columns.name: size_label
columns.comment: Size as the maker states it: '24 cm', 'large', '2 l'. Text because there is no unit the makers agree on.

columns.name: piece_count
columns.comment: How many identical pieces this row stands for. A set of six forks is one row with piece_count 6.

intents.name: kitchenware_color_id_idx
intents.comment: Leads with the referencing column of kitchenware_color_fk, and answers 'the blue ones'.

intents.name: kitchenware_kind_idx
intents.comment: All the knives, all the pans.
